title: Canadian Cheese Lasagna
description: A classic layered pasta dish with a Canadian twist, featuring melted cheese and exquisite flavors.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, combine the marinara sauce and ricotta cheese (if using).
In a separate bowl, combine the shredded cheese, exquisite cheese, and canadian cheese.
Spread a layer of marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the cheese mixture on top of the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the marinara sauce, and finally the remaining cheese mixture.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
